heading: INT. PLANETARIUM DOME, CITY MUSEUM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. PLANETARIUM DOME, CITY MUSEUM - NIGHT
A hush of velvet seats under a black ceiling stippled with fake stars.
A projector as big as a refrigerator squats in the centre like a sleeping insect.
LUCIEN DAGGETT, fifties, tuxedoed, courteous, once a stage magician, kneels at the projector with a screwdriver.
MAEVE OSHIRO, thirties, in a night-guard uniform two sizes too large, holds a flashlight and a walkie-talkie.
FELIX BRANDT, twenty, wiry, in black, dangles from a rope through a hatch in the dome.
Is the corridor clear?
units.name: LUCIEN

units.text: Clear for four minutes.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Felix. Descend.
units.name: LUCIEN

units.text: I'm descending!
units.name: FELIX

units.text: The rope pays out.
Felix swings across the dome, sneakers squeaking, and plants one foot on a seat back and the other on the projector, and the whole machine tilts.
Lucien and Maeve both lunge to steady it.
The three of them end up in a knot, Felix's rope wrapped round Maeve's arm, Lucien's screwdriver pinned under Felix's chin.
A hidden lens flares, and a thousand stars wheel across the ceiling.
Get off me.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: I can't, you're on the rope.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Both of you, be still.
units.name: LUCIEN

units.text: They hold still.
A tiny brass drawer slides out of the projector's base.
Inside lies a velvet pouch.
There you are.
units.name: LUCIEN

units.text: That's it? That's the Orion Diamond?
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: That's it.
units.name: LUCIEN

units.text: A door slams somewhere in the museum.
Footsteps.
All three freeze.
The stars keep turning overhead.
Then Lucien smiles, and tucks the pouch into his cummerbund.
